item.tib: btsan rgyal rdo rje 'bar ba'i ka bstod sprin skyes dbyar rnga ldir ba'i sgra dbyangs
item.coloph: ces pa'i btsan rgyal rdo rje 'bar ba'i ka bstod sprin skyes dbyar rnga ldir ba'i sgra dbyangs 'di/ sngon dam skabs la bab pa'i dus su tshe dbang bla ma'i rjes 'breng tshe dbang bde chen snying po'i dad ldan nag ri phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis sku rim sgrub pa'i thun mtshams su 'phral du bris pa 'dis kyang rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas 'gyur cig/
